evidence.detail: FR-PARSE-049 Rationale: 'AC-5 fills: ... / contradiction / ... a discarded holder records a closed decision that FR-PARSE-045 AC-4 already leaves unreported, so reporting either would contradict a rule the request does not reopen'. FR-PARSE-045 AC-4 (docs/spec/20.parser-validation.srs.md, block at :2972): 'THE two warnings of AC-1 and AC-2 SHALL be reported only for a requirement whose Status is neither `verified` nor `discarded`'. That rule bounds only FR-PARSE-045's own two warnings, and it also excludes verified holders, which FR-PARSE-049 does not, so reporting a discarded holder's row contradicts no rule. The checked_compatible half holds: rules section 23.5 item 3 says the status of either endpoint is not enforced.
